title: Brighton and Aston Villa face off in Premier League opener
seoTitle: Brighton vs Aston Villa: Premier League 2026/27 opener
subtitle: Match at the American Express Stadium marks the teams' debut in the competition with contrasting preparation scenarios and absences
excerpt: Get all the details on the Premier League 2026/27 clash between Brighton and Aston Villa, including probable lineups, missing players, and team overviews.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 2026/27 Premier League gets underway with a clash between Brighton and Aston Villa at the American Express Stadium. The opening matchday duel pits two teams against each other with varying degrees of stability and preparation for the start of the tournament.

Team outlook for the debut

Brighton head into the inaugural fixture with greater continuity under manager Fabian Hurzeler, who has led the squad since June 2024. The team enjoyed a positive home pre-season and retained a significant part of last season's structure, though they come into the game off the back of a 0-0 draw against Tromso in the Conference League.

On the other hand, Aston Villa are going through a rebuilding phase after the summer transfer window dismantled part of the core from their previous campaign. Manager Unai Emery is dealing with an extensive squad overhaul and a pre-season marked by defeats against high-level opponents, alongside a lengthy list of key absences.

Absences and probable lineups

Both teams take to the pitch with significant squad casualties:

  • Brighton: Evan Ferguson, Yankuba Minteh, and Stefanos Tzimas are out with injuries, while Carlos Baleba is negotiating a transfer to Manchester United. Kaoru Mitoma and Matt O'Riley are doubtful for the game.
  • Aston Villa: Amadou Onana misses out after tearing his anterior cruciate ligament. Joao Gomes suffered a calf injury and Johan Manzambi is also sidelined, alongside doubts such as Tammy Abraham and Alejandro Garnacho.

Brighton's probable lineup features Bart Verbruggen; Mats Wieffer, Luka Vuskovic, Olivier Boscagli, and Lewis Dunk; Pascal Gross and Yasin Ayari; Diego Gomez, Jack Hinshelwood, and Maxim De Cuyper; Georginio Rutter.

Aston Villa are expected to line up with Marco Bizot; Matty Cash, Victor Lindelof, Pau Torres, and Ian Maatsen; Boubacar Kamara and Ross Barkley; George Hemmings, Joao Gomes, and John McGinn; Emiliano Buendia.

Recent head-to-head record

Looking at recent history, Aston Villa hold the advantage over their opponents. They have not lost to Brighton since September 2024, accumulating three wins and a draw in their last four direct encounters, including a 1-0 result in February 2026.

With information from LANCE!, NETVASCO.
